scientific_limitations: Deterministic infinite-population well-mixed four-phenotype model with truncated Gaussian perception.
Every finite-noise global limit assumes strictly positive frequencies of all four initial phenotypes and initial resource strictly between zero and one.

Noncommuting limits and slow-time cubic profile are proved for the constant-gap payoff slice with initially independent phenotype coordinates; the numerical example has equal initial phenotype frequencies.
No nonlinear stochastic finite-population, empirical recovery, or arbitrary noise-channel assertion is made.
title: Singular resource selection and a quadratic noise clock in a Bayesian harvesting game
